summary: Peking University considers its new international master's and doctoral applicants for three scholarships through one scholarship application: the Chinese Government Scholarship for the Advanced Graduate Program (Type B), the Peking University Scholarship and the Beijing Government Scholarship. Only one award is given to a student. Study takes place at PKU in Beijing, in Chinese or English depending on the programme. Benefits differ by scholarship but include a tuition waiver, and in some cases accommodation, a monthly living allowance and medical insurance.
eligibility_notes:
Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. Former residents of mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau or Taiwan who have emigrated must supply a passport or citizenship document issued before 30 April 2021 and proof that Chinese nationality was cancelled; if the applicant is still a Chinese national, application, admission and enrolment are void. Applicants must be physically and psychologically healthy, have no criminal record, and follow Chinese law and PKU rules.

Master's applicants need a bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited institution. Doctoral applicants need a master's degree or higher; holders of only a bachelor's degree may apply for science and engineering doctorates only (generally 5 years). Academic results, level and language ability must meet the requirements of the chosen major. MBA, EMBA, IMPA, public administration and law degrees follow special national rules.

Language. Chinese-taught programmes: HSK 6 with a total above 200 (science) or above 210 (humanities), and a writing score of at least 65; new HSK levels 7 to 9 are also accepted. English-taught programmes for non-native speakers: TOEFL iBT or GRE with other accepted proof of English; the 2026 notice names TOEFL iBT 100 or above and GRE 315 or above (the 2027 text of the TOEFL figure is garbled, so check each programme's own requirement).

Scholarship conditions. For all three scholarships the applicant must meet PKU admission requirements and have applied for a full-time, self-funded graduate programme at PKU. The Chinese Government Scholarship excludes applicants who already hold another Chinese government or PKU scholarship (one-time, non-renewable merit awards are allowed); the PKU Scholarship excludes anyone who already has other scholarship funding; the Beijing Government Scholarship excludes holders of scholarships from the Chinese government, a social organisation or PKU (one-time, non-renewable merit awards are allowed). Candidates in joint training programmes are excluded from all three.
age_experience_notes: No age limit and no work experience requirement is stated in the PKU notices read.
funding_summary: Funding is a tuition waiver (full or partial) with extra components that depend on the scholarship: the Chinese Government Scholarship adds accommodation, a living stipend and medical insurance; the PKU Scholarship adds a living allowance and medical insurance; the Beijing Government Scholarship ranges from tuition only to tuition, accommodation, insurance and allowance depending on its type. Master's funding runs 2 to 3 years; doctoral funding runs 4 to 5 years (4 years under the PKU Scholarship). Awards are renewable each year only for students who take part in and pass the annual scholarship review. No money amounts are stated in the notices read.
programmes_note: The notices do not restrict fields for the scholarships; they cover PKU's programmes for international graduate students. Teaching language is Chinese or English depending on the major, and study is full-time or part-time as the Major Catalogue states. The 2027 notice names the English-taught programmes listed below. The full list of English-taught majors is published school by school: 12 schools or institutes for master's majors and 14 for doctoral majors, each linked to its own PDF.
institutions_note: Single host university: Peking University, covering the Yanyuan campus (Haidian), the new Yanyuan campus (Changping), the School of Software and Microelectronics (Daxing) and the Shenzhen Graduate School. The Health Science Center has its own separate guidelines.

benefits.limit_text: Full or partial tuition waiver (Chinese Government Scholarship, PKU Scholarship and Beijing Government Scholarship, Types A, B and C)
benefits.conditions: Whether the waiver is full or partial depends on the award. Tuition rates are in a separate PKU price list that was not read.

benefits.limit_text: Free accommodation under the Chinese Government Scholarship and Beijing Government Scholarship Types A and B
benefits.conditions: Not part of the PKU Scholarship or Beijing Government Scholarship Type C. Housing is provided only to students whose scholarship covers it; others arrange their own and, if off campus, register with the local police station within 24 hours of arrival.

benefits.limit_text: Monthly living allowance (stipend) under the Chinese Government Scholarship, the PKU Scholarship and Beijing Government Scholarship Type A
benefits.conditions: No amount is stated in the notices read. Not part of Beijing Government Scholarship Types B and C.

benefits.limit_text: Medical insurance under the Chinese Government Scholarship, the PKU Scholarship and Beijing Government Scholarship Types A, B and C
benefits.conditions: Insurance is compulsory for the whole stay: students buy the Comprehensive Insurance Plan for Foreign Students on registration day, and a student without valid cover cannot register.
The PKU notices do not mention international travel costs.

benefits.limit_text: Application fee of RMB 800 per programme, up to two programmes, non-refundable
benefits.conditions: Paid online by the applicant before the application deadline; this is a fee paid by the applicant, not a benefit.

requirements.text: Graduation and degree certificates with degree authentication, in Chinese or English; a certificate in another language needs the original plus a notarised Chinese or English copy. Overseas degrees are authenticated by CSCSE and mainland degrees by CSSD. Applicants who graduated before the entry year upload the authentication report with the application; expected graduates provide an official letter stating the expected date and hand in the certificate at pre-admission.
Official transcripts, original or notarised, in Chinese or English.
Personal statement with research plan on the official template: 1,500 words for master's, 3,000 words for doctoral applicants.
Resume and a signed Application Commitment letter on the official template.

Two recommendation letters from professors, associate professors or equivalent titled professionals in the applicant's field, in Chinese or English. The system emails each recommender a link to complete a form online or upload a signed scan.

Original language test scores: HSK for Chinese-taught programmes (HSK 6, above 200 science or above 210 humanities, writing at least 65); TOEFL iBT or GRE and other accepted proof for English-taught programmes by non-native speakers.

Front page of every ordinary passport used since 30 April 2021; the current passport must be valid at least three months beyond the enrolment date. Passport details cannot be changed after confirmation.
Table of contents and abstracts of academic publications or other original achievements.
Additional documents required by particular schools or departments.
requirements.conditional_rule: Only where the school or department asks

requirements.text: Foreigner Physical Examination Statement and a no-criminal-record self-declaration, both with a personal signature (CSC route, 2026 notice).
requirements.conditional_rule: Chinese Government Scholarship applicants who do not already provide the equivalent items in the CSC material list

requirements.text: Certificate for CSC Advanced Graduate Program application, downloaded from the application status page of the PKU system, plus the CSC application form saved from the CSC system.

Scan all originals or notarised copies in colour with a scanner; phone or camera photos are not accepted. Documents do not need to be mailed for the scholarship; pre-admitted candidates later deliver originals except diplomas and recommendation letters.

application_steps.title: Apply to PKU in the international student system
application_steps.detail: Apply to a master's or doctoral programme in the PKU International Student Service System during the admissions window (26 October to 25 December 2026, Beijing time, for the 2027 intake). Upload the documents and pay the RMB 800 fee per programme for up to two programmes; the fee is not refunded. Applicants must apply for a full-time self-funded place to be considered for a scholarship.

application_steps.title: File the PKU scholarship application
application_steps.detail: One online scholarship application in the PKU system covers all three awards. In the 2026 round it opened on the Scholarship Application page for prospective students, with a deadline of 9:00 a.m. Beijing time on 9 March; transcripts and other supporting documents are uploaded there. The 2027 dates have not yet been published in the notices read.

application_steps.title: Apply in the CSC system for the Chinese Government award
application_steps.detail: Applicants who want the Chinese Government Scholarship also apply in the CSC application system with institution code 10001 and application type B, choosing one major only, because evaluation uses that single major. The 2026 deadline was 24:00 Beijing time on 17 March; a late CSC application loses eligibility for that scholarship.

application_steps.title: Three review stages for admission
application_steps.detail: The International Student Division checks basic qualifications, school expert panels review the files and shortlist, and a second examination is held from January to March 2027 on dates set by each school. Panels judge research capacity, language ability, innovation and overall quality and rank candidates.

application_steps.title: Scholarship decision
application_steps.detail: Awards are merit-based and judged on the application submitted as a new student; only one scholarship is awarded. PKU may ask for extra material, and missing or late supplementary material means the application is treated as abandoned. Final decisions were expected by email in July and August in the 2026 round. False or invalid material leads to disqualification and possibly revocation of admission.

application_steps.title: Admission papers and pre-admission documents
application_steps.detail: Schools post a preliminary admission list by the end of May 2027. Pre-admitted candidates print the application form and deliver or mail originals (not diplomas or recommendation letters) by 31 May 2027 to the International Student Division. Admission notices and the JW201/JW202 form follow in batches from late June 2027. Admission is confirmed only by the PKU admission letter, not by any status shown in the CSC system.

application_steps.title: Visa, insurance and registration
application_steps.detail: Students staying over six months apply for an X1 visa at a Chinese embassy or consulate using the admission letter and JW201/JW202, valid 30 days after arrival, then obtain a residence permit through PKU within 30 days. Registration is in early September 2027 with passport, visa, admission letter and original diplomas (overseas degree holders also bring the CSCSE authentication report). Insurance must be bought on registration day.

application_steps.title: Annual review of the award
application_steps.detail: Chinese Government Scholarship awards are renewable each year, but only for recipients who take part in and pass the annual scholarship review.
